purpose: Prevent Driver-review stalls by making the review-to-next-work transition repository-derived and fail-closed. Any review ID not frozen in the exact legacy baseline cannot terminalize ordinary or parallel runtime authority until a valid automatic follow-up taskset is immutably published, or the current parent Objective is already canonically CLOSED. Existing concurrent control assets may satisfy a gate only by explicit pinned evidence so the rule never creates duplicate work merely to satisfy itself.
external_prior_art_minimum_scope: search independent external literature/repository sources using task-specific queries
record search date, search surfaces, queries and candidate matches
separate exact duplicate, partial antecedent, adjacent method and no material match
do not infer novelty merely from no match
return evidence refs sufficient for a Driver to audit the search
lean_task_minimum_scope: pin the exact theorem statement and source result
preserve theorem strength unless Driver explicitly issues a new weaker task
forbid sorry/admit/custom axiom when the task requires full formal closure
run the taskbook-specified warning-fatal build/check gate
freeze theorem-source blob and build provenance

automatic_materialization.transaction: preflight gate/task specifications; create the immutable review; automatically publish missing follow-up taskbook(s) and immutable publication record(s); then create one immutable review follow-up packet. Gates already represented by exact concurrent control assets are pinned rather than duplicated.
automatic_materialization.failure_semantics: fail closed; the review remains nonterminal until a valid packet exists. Any already-created partial publication remains immutable evidence and is never silently rolled back.
automatic_materialization.parent_objective_rule: all newly published follow-up task publications keep the reviewed source task parent_objective_id
automatic_materialization.revision_rule: a revision may publish a new generation of the same task only through explicit supersedes_publication_id and a new immutable taskbook path

anti_spam_and_successor_compatibility.interpretation: the review checkpoint must choose and materialize the next control action, but each CONTINUATION task must independently satisfy the existing successor_gate with a genuine information gap, discriminating outcomes, kill condition and alternative-route analysis; a concurrent already-materialized route should be pinned with SATISFIED_BY_EXISTING_CONTROL_ASSET instead of duplicated
anti_spam_and_successor_compatibility.parent_closed_behavior: do not manufacture meaningless successors; use PARENT_OBJECTIVE_CLOSURE after canonical Objective closure

historical_compatibility.cutover_basis: review_id NOT IN exact frozen legacy baseline
historical_compatibility.future_hardening: source-backed active Driver authorization remains a separate independent hardening layer; it must not weaken this frozen-ID cutover
